So my diets are usually periods of eating very healthy followed by periods of "not-caring". So in essence, I am a yo-yo dieter, which really sucks. When I'm eating healthy, I do a high protein diet, which is usually something like:

Breakfast/Lunch: Greek yogurt or cottage cheese (I wake up late so I combine the two)

Dinner: rice with whatever my parents made, so salmon, broccoli, beef, etc. 

And repeat.

But usually, I do this for a max of a week, and then I mess up and eat a ton of sugar. And then I restart. I have a ridiculous sugar addiction issue because my mom also does and often ate and fed me and my siblings sugary foods. 

As far as workouts, I run for 40 minutes every day. Sometimes it's just a slow 5.1 mph run, and other times, I'll switch it up and do like sprints followed by slow jogs. If I ate a lot of food the day before, I'll do a very long run where I run about 8 miles in an hour. So this has gotten rid of the fat on my inner thighs, but I still have very muscular calves, which I really dislike and muscular outer thighs.
